name: BNBC 2020
description: Bangladesh National Building Code 2020: Part 6 (Structural Design: loads, wind and earthquake, load combinations, reinforced concrete, seismic detailing, structural steel and foundations), Part 8 (plumbing, air-conditioning, electrical services), Part 4 (fire protection) and the standard steel sections SAEngine designs with. The values SAEngine used before code packs, transcribed from its modules; every table names its clauses and pages.

sources.title: Bangladesh National Building Code
sources.publisher: Housing and Building Research Institute (HBRI), Government of Bangladesh

wind: Sec 2.4.11.3 and Figure 6.2.9 (pp. 559, 574-575): design wind load cases
Sec 2.4.8.2 and Table 6.2.10: gust-effect factor Gf of flexible buildings
Sec 2.4.11.5: components and cladding (GCp) by zone
Other structures (open signs and lattice frameworks, trussed towers): force coefficients Cf (page not checked)
plumbing: BNBC 2020 Part 8 Chapters 5-7 and Appendices O, R, S (pp. 1034-1215)
fire: BNBC 2020 Part 1 Chapter 2 and Part 3 Sec 2.4.4 (pp. 6, 94)
fireResistance: ACI 216.1-14 (BNBC 2020 Part 6 gives no table; the ratings come from Part 4)
planning: BNBC 2020 Part 3 Chapter 1 (plot, open space, FAR and ground coverage by the planning authority's rules)
Dhaka Mohanagar Imarat Nirman Bidhimala 2008, Rules 46, 50, 51 and Tables 2, 3(A)-3(F)
timber: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 11 (timber structures), Secs 11.4-11.10 and 11.18 (pp. 285-337)
masonry: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Chapter 7 (masonry structures), Sec 7.2-7.8 (pp. 1003-1039): allowable stress design, with the strength design and earthquake values
TMS 602 / ACI 530.1 Tables 1-2: only the labelled f'm estimate from the unit strength (not BNBC)
cranes: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 1.6.6(i) (p. 502): moving loads for crane movements
fatigue: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 10.17, Eqs 6.10.276-6.10.277 and Table 6.10.14a (gazette part 2 pp. 196-210)
siteInvestigation: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.4.4-3.4.5 (pp. 702-704): number, spacing and depth of the borings
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.5.3-3.5.8, Tables 6.3.2-6.3.4 (pp. 707-714) and Appendix E: organic, expansive, collapsible, dispersive and soft soils
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 3.6.2, Tables 6.3.6a-6.3.6b (pp. 715-718) and Sec 3.10.1.29 (pp. 754-755): corrosivity and corrosive sites
BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 5.5.1-5.5.2, Table 6.5.2 (pp. 844-846): concrete in sulphate and chloride exposure
